articles.title: Two Italians killed in strike in Kuwait, as Iran denies responsibility
articles.description: The pair were technicians for German company Rheinmetall, according to Italy's foreign ministry.

articles.title: Politics and peek-a-boo in Australian parliament as senator brings baby to work
articles.description: Senator Lidia Thorpe kept 6-month-old Aaliyah entertained, as her mum Senator Fatima Payman, participated in an online safety bill debate.

articles.title: Hamas political official and wife among eight Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza
articles.description: The killings are the latest from a series of near daily attacks by Israel against what it says are Hamas targets.

articles.title: Amazon staff to strike and rally on busiest weekend of the year
articles.description: Amazon employees around the world are set to stage protests on Black Friday amid claims of unfair pay and oppressive working conditions.
